title: no-mistakes project config
description: Per-project targets for the no-mistakes verification skill family. The skills supply the METHOD (drive -> assert -> ground-truth one layer below); this file supplies the TARGETS (which BaaS/DB, which apps, which auth, which preview platform). Discovered by walking up from CWD for .no-mistakes.json, else ~/.no-mistakes/<project>.json.

project.description: Stable project identifier. Also the filename used for the central fallback (~/.no-mistakes/<project>.json).

org.description: Org/display name (e.g. PromptArmor). Used in prose/labels only.

repoOwner.description: Default GitHub owner for PR posting when an app omits its own repo.

checkoutBase.description: Base dir under which app repos are checked out (e.g. ~/PromptArmor). Used to derive a repo dir when an app omits repoPath. Supports ~.

db.description: The Backend-as-a-Service / database the read-after-write ground-truth runs against.

adapter.description: How read-after-write ground-truth is read. Derived from platform if omitted: neon/supabase/planetscale/postgres/mysql -> sql; convex -> convex; firebase -> firestore. SQL adapters read a row via run_sql; convex/firestore are non-SQL (see their blocks).

projectId.description: Platform project/instance id (e.g. Neon project id, Supabase project ref).

localBranch.description: DB branch/database the LOCAL app points at (e.g. Neon dev_personal). Ground-truth source for localhost targets.

previewBranchPattern.description: Template for the per-PR preview DB branch. {pr} is substituted with the PR number (e.g. preview-pr-{pr}).

connStringEnv.description: Env var name the harness expects the resolved connection string in (e.g. NMB_DATABASE_URL). Value is resolved at runtime via MCP, never stored here.

migrations.description: Migration tool, for the migration-state gate. 'none' disables the gate.

migrationsVersionTable.description: Table holding the applied migration version (e.g. alembic_version).

mcp.description: SQL adapter: MCP tool names for DB ground-truth. Defaults match the Neon MCP server.

convex.description: Convex (non-SQL) ground-truth adapter. Convex has no SQL — read via the CLI/MCP and assert on returned documents, not rows. Used when adapter=convex.

deploymentEnv.description: Env var holding the deployment (e.g. CONVEX_DEPLOYMENT).

urlEnv.description: Env var holding the deployment URL (e.g. CONVEX_URL / NEXT_PUBLIC_CONVEX_URL).

deployKeyEnv.description: Env var holding a preview/deployment-scoped deploy key.

runCmd.description: CLI to invoke a query function.

firestore.description: Firestore (non-SQL) ground-truth adapter. Read by document path via Admin SDK / MCP; bypasses Security Rules; no DB branching (isolate per-PR via a separate project or the emulator). Used when adapter=firestore.

isolation.description: How per-PR isolation is achieved (Firestore has no DB branching).

preview.description: Per-PR preview environment platform and the ports/services the harness drives.

evidence.description: Ignored. Screenshots and clips upload as GitHub attachments; remove this key.

auth.description: Auth surfaces the harness mints/uses. Each app references a profile by key.

apiKeyHeader.description: Custom API-key header to treat as sensitive/redact (e.g. X-PromptArmor-API-Key).

profiles.description: Named auth profiles keyed by id (referenced by app.auth).

kind.description: How a token is obtained. 'propelauth' uses the api-token.mjs minter; 'bearer-env' reads a key straight from a secret env var; 'supabase-jwt' / 'firebase-idtoken' / 'none' for other platforms.

secretsScopeDir.description: Dir to cd into so the secrets tool resolves the right scope (e.g. the app repo).

env.description: Map of logical name -> env var holding the secret (e.g. {authUrl: PROPEL_AUTH_TEST_AUTH_URL, apiKey: PROPEL_AUTH_TEST_API_KEY}).

keyEnv.description: For bearer-env: the env var holding the bearer token/key.

apiPaths.description: For propelauth: API paths the minter calls.

noLogin.description: App needs no interactive login (internal tool).

apps.description: The deployable units the skills drive. At least one.

repoPath.description: Local checkout path. If omitted, derived from checkoutBase + repo basename. Supports ~.

devCommand.description: Command to start it locally (e.g. pnpm run dev, make api).

browserProfile.description: agent-browser session name prefix (frontend); each run appends its run id.

auth.description: Key into auth.profiles. Omit/none for no auth.

previewSlug.description: Short slug used to match this app in preview detection.

errorEnvelope.description: Backend custom validation-error envelope shape, asserted on 422 (e.g. {status_code, message, data}).
